editor_note: All five rewritten entries keep the English meaning. The 4710/4712 error codes, the requirement for explicit integer bounds, the postprocessing value mapping and the "defaultnya tetap 3" default all match the source. Entries 44 and 68 switch to the informal pronouns "kamu"/"milikmu", while the rest of the page uses "Anda" throughout. Entries 67 and 68 use the English "circuit", but the rest of the page says "sirkuit" (entries 7, 16, 20). In entry 67 the heading "Breaking changes" is left in English, while its sibling headings are translated ("Fitur", "Dokumentasi").

examples.source: tells you which character position of a bitstring belongs to which variable

examples.suggested: menunjukkan posisi karakter mana dalam bitstring yang merupakan milik variabel mana (or: memberi tahu Anda ...)
examples.why: The page addresses the reader as "Anda" everywhere else; switching to "kamu" here breaks the page's register. "yang menjadi milik" is also a slightly stiff calque of "belongs to".

examples.source: to make circuit synthesis and routing reproducible across runs ... to attach your own tags
examples.translation: supaya sintesis dan routing circuit bisa direproduksi di setiap run ... melampirkan tag milikmu sendiri
examples.suggested: supaya sintesis dan routing sirkuit bisa direproduksi antar-run ... melampirkan tag Anda sendiri
examples.why: The rest of the page renders circuit as "sirkuit" (entries 7, 16, 20) and uses "Anda". Using English "circuit" and "milikmu" here is inconsistent.

examples.translation: **Breaking changes** ... tidak ada circuit yang dijalankan
examples.suggested: **Perubahan yang tidak kompatibel** ... tidak ada sirkuit yang dijalankan
examples.why: This heading stays in English while the sibling headings "Fitur" and "Dokumentasi" are translated, and "circuit" again differs from the page's "sirkuit".

editor_note: Entry 28 is faithful and reads naturally. "the QPU time is minimal and almost constant" becomes "waktu QPU minimal dan hampir konstan", and the causal clause "karena hanya satu putaran QAOA ... parameter sirkuit optimal yang diperoleh pada CPU" keeps the English meaning without drift.

The three rewritten entries (40, 41, 44) keep their meaning. The numbers all match the English: below 10% at width 9 (10 qubits), Orbit at 80–90%, about 15% near width 60, and N = 50 with 51 qubits. The caveat that results depend on calibration and settings is also kept. Two small things remain. Entry 41 uses "probabilitas sukses", but the rest of the page (entries 23, 25, 33) uses "probabilitas keberhasilan" for "success probability". Entry 41 also leaves the English noun in "Run penskalaan representatif", which reads as a calque; "Eksekusi penskalaan representatif" would be more natural Indonesian.

examples.source: Orbit can help preserve Bernstein-Vazirani success probability
examples.suggested: mempertahankan probabilitas keberhasilan Bernstein-Vazirani (also 'probabilitas keberhasilan mentah' and 'probabilitas keberhasilan yang tidak sepele' later in the entry)
examples.why: The rest of the file uses 'probabilitas keberhasilan' for 'success probability' (entries 23, 25, 33), so this entry is inconsistent with it.

examples.source: The representative scaling runs below compare raw execution with Orbit configurations
examples.translation: Run penskalaan representatif di bawah ini membandingkan eksekusi mentah
examples.suggested: Eksekusi penskalaan representatif di bawah ini membandingkan eksekusi mentah
examples.why: Using the English noun 'Run' at the start of the sentence is a calque. 'Eksekusi' (already used in entry 22 for 'Orbit runs') reads more naturally.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries keep their meaning. In entry 72, Q is still the CNOT control, Alice's qubit is still the target, and the Hadamard still follows on Q. Entry 73's grouping sentence ("kelompokkan suku-suku di atas berdasarkan hasil pengukuran pada qubit A dan Q") is faithful, and its math is unchanged. The one issue is in entry 72: "Alice sekarang beroperasi dengan Gate CNOT" copies the English "operates with" word for word and reads stiffly in Indonesian. The rest of the page says "menerapkan Gate", as entry 64 and the same sentence's "menerapkan Gate Hadamard" do, so this should match.

examples.source: Alice now operates with a CNOT gate with Q as the control and her own qubit as the target, then applies a Hadamard gate to Q.
examples.translation: Alice sekarang beroperasi dengan Gate CNOT dengan Q sebagai kontrol dan qubit-nya sendiri sebagai target, kemudian menerapkan Gate Hadamard ke Q.
examples.suggested: Alice sekarang menerapkan Gate CNOT dengan Q sebagai kontrol dan qubit-nya sendiri sebagai target, kemudian menerapkan Gate Hadamard pada Q.
examples.why: "beroperasi dengan" copies "operates with" word for word and sounds stiff in Indonesian. Elsewhere the page says "menerapkan Gate" (entry 64, and later in this same sentence), so using it here reads better and keeps the wording consistent.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries say the same thing as the English. Entry 78 ('beberapa optima degenerate', 'diakses berdasarkan nama variabel', the variable_mapping clause) and entry 87 need no changes. Entry 53 breaks the page's conventions in two ways. It switches to the casual 'Kalau kamu ingin...' when every other entry addresses the reader as 'Anda'. It also uses the English 'circuit' ('pemetaan circuit') where the rest of the page says 'sirkuit' (entries 7, 52, 64).

examples.source: If you want the circuit mapping to be reproducible across runs, fix the `seed_transpiler` option.
examples.translation: Kalau kamu ingin pemetaan circuit bisa direproduksi di setiap run, tetapkan opsi `seed_transpiler`.
examples.suggested: Jika Anda ingin pemetaan sirkuit dapat direproduksi di setiap run, tetapkan opsi `seed_transpiler`.
examples.why: Every other entry on the page uses 'Anda' (entries 22, 33, 73, 87), so the switch to the casual 'kalau kamu' stands out.
The rest of the page renders 'circuit' as 'sirkuit' ('sintesis sirkuit' in 7 and 52, 'Mensintesis sirkuit' in 64), so using the English word here is inconsistent.

editor_note: Entry 60 says the same thing as the English: "Benchmark fidelitas proses QFT dengan Orbit, sebuah Qiskit Function oleh Quantum Elements" correctly renders "process fidelity" as "fidelitas proses", keeps "Qiskit Function" in English per house style, and uses "Benchmark" the same way as entry 46.

Entry 12 is faithful and reads naturally: the random positive/negative $J_{ij}$ distribution, the triangle example and "frustrasi ini diperparah secara global, sehingga menghasilkan jaringan batasan yang saling bertentangan" all match the English with no drift.

The 23 rewritten entries keep their meaning. Quantities (300 PUBs, 921.600 shot, 60 PUBs = 20 × 3), conditions and caveats all match the English, and nothing would mislead a learner. What a native editor would still fix is wording and consistency. Some terms appear in several forms: "classical-control" (entry 5) next to "kontrol klasik" (32, 46), and "two-qubit-gate"/"gate single qubit" (17) next to "gate dua qubit" (33). The English plural "child jobs" (5) and the reversed "ID job Runtime child" (51) sit next to "child job" everywhere else. A few phrases follow English word order: "basis label" for "label basis" (31) and "berisi 300 PUB masing-masing" (49). "Dipilih oleh kalibrasi" (43) reads as if the calibration does the choosing.

examples.source: The default groups combine large and small circuits and contain 300 PUBs each
examples.translation: Kelompok default menggabungkan circuit besar dan kecil serta berisi 300 PUB masing-masing
